Title: Advanced Permissions for Umbraco — AI Copilot Tools
Description: Optional AI companion for Advanced Permissions for Umbraco. It makes the Umbraco backoffice copilot permission-aware, so editors can ask in plain language who can do what, why an action is blocked, and what would fix it, plus audit a user group or a branch of the tree for risks and get the permission model itself explained. Every answer is computed by the package's own permission-resolution engine, including the reasoning behind it, so the copilot stops guessing. Strictly read-only. Requires Umbraco AI with a configured copilot chat.

AuthorDetails.Name: Luuk Peters
AuthorDetails.Description: Umbraco developer building packages that extend the CMS with enterprise-grade features. Creator of Advanced Permissions for Umbraco.

Screenshots.Caption: Ask in plain language why an action is blocked. The answer comes from the package's own permission resolver, not from the model's guesswork.
The tools stay disabled until you allow them: tick 'Advanced Permissions (read)' in your chat agent's governance.
Ask what would fix it. Every option is verified against the resolver before it is offered, and it describes the change rather than applying it.
